name: numeric-conversion-test-6b3e1e5e00/nan-float-union-as-int-p.bal
reason: The case computes float NaN with 0.0 / 0.0, stores it in float|int, and asserts a panic when casting that NaN to int. Arithmetic, local declarations, calls and type casts are supported, with no restriction excluding union-source numeric casts or NaN conversion failure.
test_design_notes: The // @panic annotation asserts runtime rejection of the NaN-to-int cast.
